---
name: Device support or tester request
about: Suggest a manufacturer, device, interface or physical testing contribution
title: "[DEVICE] "
---

## Equipment

Manufacturer, exact model, firmware and installed interface module.

## Connection method

Documented LAN API, Modbus TCP/RTU, BACnet, M-Bus, USB, Zigbee or other.
Attach manufacturer manuals or official reference links.

## Local-first feasibility

What already works with the internet disconnected? Does initial pairing
or key provisioning require a vendor service?

## Available test evidence

Describe which sensor readings match the physical controller.
Do not claim control-write support without isolated physical validation.

## Privacy and safety

Do not publish local keys, serial numbers, passwords or customer addresses.
